personality_one_liner: A professional, highly-legible field utility merging native structural clarity with outdoor-ready contrast and botanical accents.

spacing.rule: Generous padding around content to ensure touch accuracy in the field. Avoid dense dashboard clusters. Maintain minimum 56pt tappable height for lists.

do's: Floating header elements on the Map screen

screens.name: Map
screens.purpose: Full-screen interactive map to visualize all marked kroto tree locations.

states.loading: Map skeleton or centered spinner over a muted map grid.
states.empty: Map centered on current GPS location, single prompt overlay to 'Mark First Tree'.
states.error: Full-screen error asking to enable Location Permissions.

screens.layout: ZStack approach: react-native-maps MapView behind floating UI. Top floating search/filter bar using glass effect. Large primary FAB (pill-shaped) at bottom-right for 'Tandai Lokasi' (Mark Location). Bottom sheet (@gorhom/bottom-sheet) triggers when a pin is tapped to show quick details (Status, Next Harvest, distance) and a CTA to view full details. Map pins should be color-coded (e.g., brandPrimary for ready, muted for cooldown).

screens.name: Daftar Lokasi (List)
screens.purpose: Searchable, sortable list view of all tracked trees.

states.empty: Illustration of a forest path with text 'Belum ada pohon ditandai' and 'Tambah Lokasi' CTA.
states.error: Readable message with a Retry button.

screens.layout: Sticky search bar at the top. List rows with generous padding (min 56pt height). Each row features a small thumbnail image (or initials fallback in a brandTertiary circle), Tree Name, Last Visit timestamp, and a Status Badge (Ready/Cooldown). Single column list.

screens.name: Detail Lokasi
screens.purpose: Deep dive into a specific tree location showing history, photos, and exact GPS data.

states.loading: Spinner centered on a blank layout.
states.empty: N/A - Data always exists if opened.
states.error: Failed to load details error with Retry button.

screens.layout: Large hero image photo of the tree at the top with a top-to-bottom gradient scrim (dark at bottom) and back button overlaid. Content below scrolls: Title, Address/GPS coords (use a Mono font like JetBrains Mono for exact coords to look technical), Notes. A 'Riwayat Kunjungan' section showing a timeline/list of previous harvests. Sticky primary CTA 'Catat Panen' pinned to the bottom (safe area aware).

screens.name: Riwayat Panen (Log Form)
screens.purpose: Form to record a new visit or harvest log.
screens.layout: Single column form. Labels above inputs. Photo uploader block (allows taking/picking photos). Date/Time picker for harvest time. Slider or input for harvest amount. Next harvest schedule setter. Submit sticky at bottom inside KeyboardAvoidingView.

default_tree_header.alt: Close up of forest tree trunk texture

instructions_to_main_agent: Design for outdoor utility first: use strict WCAG AA contrast ratios because this app will be used under bright sunlight. The map screen is the primary interface.
The UI is built on '1 iOS-Native Clean' structure but infused with outdoor tracking utility logic. Avoid soft/muddy colors; stick to sharp white/black and the distinct Forest Green brand tone.
Implement a Z-stack structure for the Map screen: `react-native-maps` forms the base, with a floating search/filter header on top (glass effect) and a Gorhom Bottom Sheet for location details.
Always use a gradient scrim (top-to-bottom, ending at 70%+ dark inverse surface) under any text placed on hero images (like tree photos).
Use a Mono font (e.g., Space Mono or JetBrains Mono) explicitly for GPS coordinates and timestamps to provide a technical, reliable feel.
Implement a dedicated color status for markers/lists: BrandPrimary (Green) for 'Ready to Harvest', Warning (Orange) or Muted for 'Cooldown/Recently Harvested'.

Provide a robust Dark Mode implementation. Dark mode tokens should map to: surface: #121412, surfaceSecondary: #1C1D1C, brandPrimary: #4E875F (lighter for contrast). Maintain the same iOS-native layout rhythms.
When a user opens the app, the bottom sheet should rest in an unobtrusive closed/peek state, leaving the map clear for navigation. Tapping a pin brings it to the middle snap point.
For the 'Tandai Lokasi' button over the map, use a prominent FAB pill inside the safe area, clear of the bottom sheet snap points.
